open_points.subject: flow:author_and_admit_function cleanup after an explicit try
open_points.text: “If it cannot confirm that, it reports the execution `crashed` with `cleanup_failed` ... `module:functions` writes that TrialExecution ... the next submission of the same implementation finds no verdict and runs admission again.”
open_points.question: Does the claim that no verdict exists and admission reruns apply only when cleanup failed during admission, or also when it failed during an explicit try that may already have an AdmissionVerdict for the current corpus?
options: Apply it only to an interrupted admission; an explicit try leaves any existing verdict reusable
Invalidate or disregard an existing verdict after cleanup failure during an explicit try
Always rerun admission after either cleanup-failure path
open_points.default_guess: Apply it only to an interrupted admission; an explicit try does not alter or invalidate an existing verdict.

open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval outcome authority
open_points.text: “The effect sent once, on the exact request the owner was shown or under the owner's grant” contradicts “a `draft-write` node needs nothing at run time — its authority is the version's FlowActivation.”
open_points.question: Must the stated outcome include `draft-write` sends authorized by the flow activation, in addition to sends authorized by an exact approval or a standing grant?
options: Include the run's FlowActivation as the third authority form
Require an exact approval or grant for `draft-write` too
open_points.default_guess: Include the run's FlowActivation as the third authority form.

open_points.subject: flow:run_effect_with_approval send count
open_points.text: “The effect sent once” conflicts with the specified resends after `not_sent` and after an unknown outcome resolved `not_applied`.
open_points.question: Does “sent once” mean one HTTP request per EffectAttempt, or at most one send for the element over its entire run?
options: One send per EffectAttempt; later attempts are allowed under the stated authority rules
At most one send per element for the entire run
Only `not_sent` may create another attempt; resolved `not_applied` may not be resent
open_points.default_guess: One send per EffectAttempt; later attempts remain allowed exactly where the resend rules permit them.
